Two cannelloni with meat sauce and cheese, plus a bowl of mixed vegetables (carrots, broccoli, corn).

Cannelloni: about 2 pieces at roughly 120 g each, so about 240 g. At about 1.6 kcal/g that is roughly 390 kcal.

Vegetables: about 110 g at about 0.6 kcal/g, so roughly 65 kcal.

Total: about 350 g and about 455 kcal.
